invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破1950（基于ATR 19.0025和支撑），或融资费率Z-score转正>0%（空头风险缓解），或日线趋势转熊（价格跌破SMA50 2041.13）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 1950 (based on ATR 19.0025 and support), or funding Z-score turns positive >0% (short risk eases), or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50 2041.13).
